_aciklama: Karakter başına ses. 'design' = Voice Design API'ye giden İngilizce tarif (tools/voice_gen.py design). 'voice_id' 'pick' ya da 'cast' adımıyla dolar. 'same_as' başka karakterin sesini kullanır. stability düşük = daha duygulu (v3 modelinde 0 / 0.5 / 1'e yuvarlanır).

SPK_TOLGA.tarif: 30'larında sigortacı; hızlı, şaşkın, iyimser, plaza jargonlu
SPK_TOLGA.design: Turkish man in his early 30s, insurance office worker from Istanbul. Fast, slightly nasal, easily flustered, optimistic, talks in corporate buzzwords. Comedic, expressive, modern Istanbul accent.

SPK_HIKMET.tarif: 70'lerinde mucit amca; sıcak, hafif çatlak, heyecanlı
SPK_HIKMET.design: Turkish man in his early 70s, eccentric garage inventor, the hero's uncle. Warm, slightly cracked and raspy voice, excitable, grandfatherly, chuckles often. Istanbul Turkish.

SPK_NIHAT.tarif: Büro denetçisi; tekdüze, resmî, kuru mizah
SPK_NIHAT.design: Turkish man in his late 40s, a time-bureau auditor. Monotone, dry, precise, bureaucratic, deadpan humour, never raises his voice. Clear standard Turkish, slightly nasal.

SPK_MUFIDE.tarif: Başdenetçi, orta yaş kadın; anaç ama kesin
SPK_MUFIDE.design: Turkish woman in her 50s, chief auditor of a bureau. Motherly but firm and decisive, crisp articulation, calm authority, a hint of warmth.

SPK_RIZA.design: Turkish man in his 50s, a warehouse keeper. Deep, slow, relaxed, easy-going, streetwise, speaks like he has seen it all.

SPK_NIKO.tarif: Bizans nöbetçisi; gür, iyi kalpli, hafif kaba
SPK_NIKO.design: Greek Byzantine city guard in his 40s speaking Turkish with a light Greek accent. Loud, booming, good-hearted, a bit rough, jovial.

SPK_KADRI.tarif: Aşçıbaşı; kalın, gürleyen, sert ama sevecen
SPK_KADRI.design: Ottoman head cook in his 50s. Very deep, thick, booming voice, gruff and loud but affectionate, shouts orders in a busy kitchen.

SPK_LUTFI.design: Ottoman interpreter in his 30s. Quick, witty, eager, sly and playful, talks fast, speaks many languages, slightly theatrical.

SPK_URBAN.tarif: Macar topçu ustası; gururlu, gürültülü, yabancı aksanlı
SPK_URBAN.design: Hungarian cannon master in his 50s speaking Turkish with a strong Central European accent. Proud, loud, boastful, dramatic, rolling Rs.

SPK_HASAN.design: Young Ottoman Janissary, about 20. Naive, a bit slow, sincere, friendly, slightly dopey comedic delivery.

SPK_HUSEYIN.tarif: Hasan'ın ikizi gibi; biraz daha tiz
SPK_HUSEYIN.design: Young Ottoman Janissary, about 20, twin-like companion of Hasan. Naive and friendly with a slightly higher, more nervous pitch.

SPK_GUARDS.tarif: Hasan ile Hüseyin birlikte (Hasan'ın sesi kullanılır)

SPK_SOLDIER.design: Very young Ottoman soldier, about 18. Innocent, homesick, soft-spoken, talks about his mother, earnest.

SPK_CLERK.design: Byzantine palace clerk in his 40s. Dry, ceremonial, nasal, pedantic, speaks as if reading regulations aloud.

SPK_THEODOROS.design: Elderly Byzantine chancellor (Logothetes) in his 60s. Slow, grave, ceremonial, dignified, secretly emotional, deep and resonant.

SPK_GIUST.tarif: Cenevizli komutan; kendinden emin, tüccar kurnazlığı
SPK_GIUST.design: Genoese military commander in his 40s speaking Turkish with an Italian accent. Self-assured, charismatic, merchant-like cunning, smooth.

SPK_EMPEROR.design: Byzantine emperor in his late 40s. Dignified, weary, warm, noble and restrained, speaks softly with gravity. Must sound respectful and human.

SPK_FATIH.tarif: Genç Sultan Mehmed; 21 yaşında, sakin, keskin, otoriter (saygılı)
SPK_FATIH.design: Young Ottoman sultan, 21 years old. Calm, sharp, intelligent, quietly authoritative, measured pace, clear and confident. Respectful, never cartoonish.

SPK_CANDARLI.design: Hooded mysterious man in his 50s. Low, whispery, secretive, conspiratorial voice.

SPK_PASHA.tarif: Çandarlı Halil Paşa; yaşlı, kurnaz, alçak sesli
SPK_PASHA.design: Elderly Ottoman grand vizier in his 60s. Low-voiced, cunning, cautious, politely menacing, speaks slowly and deliberately.

SPK_CEMIL.tarif: Yaşlı hırdavatçı esnaf; yavaş, dost, çay seven
SPK_CEMIL.design: Elderly Istanbul hardware-shop owner in his late 60s. Slow, friendly, chatty neighbourhood shopkeeper, warm, loves tea.

SPK_AGENT1.design: Bureau agent in his 40s. Polite but robotic and flat, overly formal, emotionless, like an automated announcement.

SPK_AGENT2.design: Bureau agent in his 40s. Polite, formal and flat, slightly warmer and softer than his partner, fond of tea.

SPK_AGA.tarif: Sorucu Ağa; gür, bağıran, köprü bekçisi tiyatrosu
SPK_AGA.design: Ottoman gatekeeper officer in his 40s. Loud, booming, theatrical, shouts his questions like a bridge-keeper in a comedy, very expressive.

SPK_CAMELEER.design: Anatolian camel driver in his 40s. Excited, rustic, village accent, talks fast and loud, cheerful.

SPK_DERVISH.design: Elderly Sufi dervish. Soft, dreamy, poetic, slow, serene and slightly otherworldly.

SPK_TAILOR.design: Venetian tailor in his 40s speaking Turkish with an Italian accent. Fussy, hurried, dramatic, talks with his hands.

SPK_MANAGER.design: Turkish office manager in his 50s. Corporate, impatient, fake-cheerful, speaks in meeting jargon, slightly pompous.

SPK_DRIVER.tarif: Servis şoförü; sesli repliği yok (yalnız sahne notu)

SPK_CAPTAIN.design: Venetian ship captain in his 50s speaking Turkish with an Italian accent. Weathered, gravelly, confident, seafaring.

SPK_WINE.design: Genoese wine merchant in his 40s speaking Turkish with an Italian accent. Busy, dismissive, bureaucratic, fast talker.

SPK_NOTARY.tarif: Ceneviz noter; titiz, yavaş, mühür meraklısı
SPK_NOTARY.design: Genoese notary in his 60s speaking Turkish with an Italian accent. Precise, slow, pedantic, obsessed with seals and stamps.

SPK_DOUBLE.tarif: İki tarafa satan tüccar; sinsi, güler yüzlü
SPK_DOUBLE.design: Shady arms dealer in his 40s. Smooth, sly, cheerful salesman voice, sells to both sides, winks in every sentence.

SPK_FISHMONGER.design: Galata fishmonger in his 40s. Loud market crier, cheerful, hoarse from shouting.

SPK_ENVOY.design: Venetian envoy in his 50s speaking Turkish with an Italian accent. Diplomatic, smooth, polished, courteous.

SPK_MINER.design: Ottoman tunnel miner in his 50s. Low, gravelly, tired, speaks quietly because of the tunnel, dry humour.

SPK_SINERJI.tarif: Tavuk; seslendirilmez, oyun tavuk efekti çalar

SPK_COWORKER_A.design: Turkish office worker in her late 20s. Chatty, gossipy, upbeat, modern Istanbul accent.

SPK_COWORKER_B.design: Turkish office worker in his early 30s. Sarcastic, bored, dry, modern Istanbul accent.
